Filter Panel

Filter Panel is a sidebar-style filter interface with collapsible sections, count badges, range sliders, and apply/clear actions. Ideal for e-commerce product filtering and dashboard sidebar filtering.

Collapsible filter sections with checkboxes, counts, and range sliders.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
function toggleFPSection(btn) {
  var content = btn.parentElement.querySelector('.fp-section-content');
  var arrow = btn.querySelector('span:last-child');
  var isHidden = content.style.display === 'none';
  content.style.display = isHidden ? '' : 'none';
  arrow.style.transform = isHidden ? '' : 'rotate(-90deg)';
}

function updateFP() {
  var summary = document.getElementById('fp-summary');
  var count = 0;
  summary.innerHTML = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('.fp-filter:checked').forEach(function (cb) {
    count++;
    var label = cb.closest('label').textContent.trim().split('\n')[0].trim();
    var chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'zak-badge';
    chip.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.75rem;';
    chip.innerHTML = label + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">&times;</button>';
    chip.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () { cb.checked = false; updateFP(); });
    summary.appendChild(chip);
  });
  document.getElementById('fp-result-count').textContent = Math.max(63 - count * 8, 3);
}

function applyFP() { updateFP(); }
function clearFP() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fp-filter').forEach(function (cb) { cb.checked = false; });
  document.getElementById('fp-price-min').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fp-price-max').value = '';
  updateFP();
}
